description: Use this when the user asks what a domain extension costs, where it is cheapest, or what it renews at. Returns dated first-year, renewal and transfer prices per registrar (Porkbun, Dynadot, Cloudflare, Namecheap where tracked), the cheapest direct buy, the wholesale floor, and a renewal-trap flag when the renewal is 2x+ the intro price. Prices are the TLD standard price, not premium names. Also answers "what does it cost over 5 years": true_cost gives each registrar's 1/3/5/10-year cost, the cheapest path per horizon (stay, or register at one and transfer after year one for gTLDs) and recent renewal price changes, each with source URL and checked date.

items.description: A TLD without or with the dot, e.g. "ai" or ".io"
